finding.claim: Client connects to a predictable named pipe without verifying server identity, so a local squatter that creates the pipe first receives agent requests including sign data and can return forged responses.
finding.source: Pipe name from OS username plus CryptProtectMemory suffix of constant Pageant (namedpipes.rs 49-53, 95-120). Attacker must be able to create that pipe name, e.g. same logon session; key scope not verified.
finding.sink: ClientOptions open at namedpipes.rs:33 connects to whichever server answers.

finding.guards_checked: No server identity verification anywhere in crate. Pipe name uses OS username, not attacker input. Retry loop at lines 31-44 handles only pipe busy.
